JavaScript InstantSearch.js is an open source UI library for vanilla JS that lets you build a search interface in your frontend app. InstantSearch focuses on enhancing your frontend with widgets that you can combine to create unique search interfaces. InstantSearch offers three levels of increasing control over your UI: 1. Start with a predefined widget that you can configure and style with CSS. 2. To change its render output (DOM or Native), customize a predefined widget to render what you want. 3. To implement something that doesn’t exist, create a custom widget.
